verses.text: Peter, apostle of Jesus Christ, to di chosen people wey dey live as foreigners and scatter for Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia and Bithynia,
according to di foreknowledge of Papa God, as di Spirit make una holy, so that una go obey Jesus Christ and dem go sprinkle una with im blood: Make grace and peace plenty for una.
Make we bless di God and Papa of our Lord Jesus Christ, wey according to im great mercy give us new birth to living hope through di resurrection of Jesus Christ from di dead,
to inheritance wey no fit spoil, wey no dey dirty and wey no dey fade, wey dem keep for heaven for una,
una wey God power dey guard through faith for salvation wey ready to show for di last time.
For dis one una dey rejoice well well, even though now for small time, if e must be, una don sorrow for different trials,
so that di proof of una faith, wey precious pass gold wey dey perish even though dem dey test am with fire, go bring praise, glory and honor when Jesus Christ show;
wey una no see before but una love; and even though una no see am now, una believe am, and una dey rejoice with joy wey no fit talk and wey full of glory;
as una dey receive di result of una faith, di salvation of una souls.
About dis salvation, di prophets look for am and search am well well, di prophets wey talk about di grace wey go come to una,
as dem dey search wetin time or which kind time di Spirit of Christ wey dey inside dem dey point to, when e talk before about di sufferings of Christ and di glories wey go follow.

God show dem say dem no dey serve demself, but una, for dese things, wey now dem don announce to una through dem wey preach di Good News to una by Holy Spirit wey dem send from heaven; and angels wan look inside dese things.
So make una prepare una mind, make una keep clear mind, and put una hope full for di grace wey dey come to una when Jesus Christ show;
as obedient pikin dem, no follow una former desire dem wey una get for time wey una no know,
but just as di one wey call una dey holy, make una too dey holy for all una behavior;
because dem write am say, “Una go dey holy, because I dey holy.”
If una call am Papa, di one wey judge everybody according to im work without favoritism, make una live fear God for di time wey una dey stay here as foreigners:
as una know say dem don free una, no be with things wey dey perish, like silver or gold, from di empty way of life wey una forefathers hand down to una,
but with precious blood, like blood of lamb wey no get fault or spot, di blood of Christ;
wey God know before di foundation of di world, but e show for di end of times for una sake,
una wey through am believe God, wey raise am from di dead and give am glory; so that una faith and hope go dey for God.
As una don make una souls clean by obeying di truth through di Spirit for true love for brothers, make una love each other from di heart with strong love:
as dem don born una again, no be from seed wey dey perish, but from seed wey no dey perish, through di word of God, wey dey alive and dey remain forever.
Because, “All flesh dey like grass, and all im glory dey like flower for grass. Di grass dey dry, and im flower dey fall;
but di Lord word dey remain forever.” Na dis word be di Good News wey dem preach to una.
So put away all wickedness, all deceit, hypocrisy, envy and all evil talk,
and like newborn babies, long for di pure milk of di Word, so that with am una go grow reach salvation;
if una don taste say Lord dey good.
As una dey come to am, di living stone, wey men reject but wey God choose and e precious,
una too, like living stones, dem dey build una up as spiritual house, to be holy priesthood, to offer spiritual sacrifices wey God go accept through Jesus Christ.
Because dem write am for Scripture, “Look, I dey put for Zion one chief cornerstone, chosen and precious: Di one wey believe am no go shame.”
So di honor na for una wey believe, but for dem wey no believe, “Di stone wey di builders reject, na im become di head of di corner,”
and, “stone wey dey make people stumble, and rock wey dey make people fall.” Dem dey stumble for di word, because dem disobey, and na for dis dem appoint dem too.
But una na chosen race, royal priesthood, holy nation, people wey be God own, so that una go declare di excellent things of di one wey call una comot from darkness enter im wonderful light;
una wey before no be people, but now una na God people, wey never receive mercy, but now una don receive mercy.
Dear ones, I beg una as foreigners and travelers, make una stay far from desire of flesh, wey dey fight against di soul;
make una get good behavior among di Gentiles; so that for wetin dem dey talk against una as evildoers, dem go see una good works and give glory to God for di day wey e visit dem.
So submit to every human authority for Lord sake, whether to di king, as di highest,
or to governors, as e send dem to punish evildoers and to praise dem wey do good.
Because na dis God will be, say by doing good una go shut di mouth of foolish men wey no know:
as free people, and no use una freedom as cover for wickedness, but as God servants.
Honor all men. Love di brotherhood. Fear God. Honor di king.
Servants, submit to una oga with all respect, no be only to di good and gentle ones, but to di wicked too.
Because e dey praiseworthy if person endure sorrow and suffer wrongly because im conscience dey for God.
Because wetin glory dey if una sin and una take punishment patiently? But if una do good and una endure suffering patiently, dis one na praiseworthy before God.
Because na for dis dem call una, because Christ too suffer for us, e leave example for una, so that una go follow im steps,
wey no sin, “and dem no find deceit for im mouth”;
wey when dem insult am, e no insult back; when e suffer, e no threaten; but e hand imself over to di one wey dey judge righteously;
wey carry our sins for im own body for di tree, so that we go die to sins and live for righteousness; by im wounds una don heal.
Because una dey wander like sheep, but now una don return to di Shepherd and Overseer of una souls.
Na so too, wives, submit to una own husbands; so that even if some no obey di word, dem go win dem without word through di behavior of dem wives;
as dem see una pure behavior wey get respect.
No make una beauty be di outside beauty of braid hair, gold jewelry or fine cloth;
but make am be di hidden person of di heart, with di beauty wey no dey perish of gentle and quiet spirit, wey precious well well before God.
Because na so di holy women before, wey put dem hope for God, dey make demself fine, as dem dey submit to dem own husbands:
like how Sarah obey Abraham, as e dey call am oga. Una don become im pikin dem now, if una do good and no let any terror make una fear.

Una husbands, na so too, live with una wives with understanding, as una dey honor di woman like di weaker one, and as dem too dey share di grace of life with una, so that nothing go block una prayers.
Finally, make all of una dey agree, dey compassionate, dey love each other like brothers, dey tenderhearted and humble,
no pay evil back with evil, or insult with insult; but instead bless dem; because una know say na for dis dem call una, so that una go inherit blessing.
Because, “Di person wey wan love life and see good days, make e keep im tongue from evil and im lips from deceit.
Make e turn comot from evil and do good. Make e look for peace and follow am.
Because di eyes of di Lord dey on di righteous, and im ears dey open to dem prayer; but di face of di Lord dey against dem wey dey do evil.”
Who go harm una, if una dey follow wetin good?
But even if una suffer because of righteousness, una dey blessed. “No fear dem threats, and no let am trouble una.”
But make una honor Lord God as holy inside una heart; and always dey ready to give answer to everybody wey ask una reason for di hope wey dey inside una, with humility and respect:
as una get good conscience; so that when dem dey talk against una as evildoers, dem wey dey insult una good way of life for Christ go shame.
Because e better, if na God will, say una suffer because una do good than because una do evil.
Because Christ too suffer for sins one time, di righteous for di unrighteous, so that e go bring una to God; dem kill am for flesh, but e come alive for spirit;
and for di spirit e go preach to di spirits wey dey prison,
wey disobey before, when God patience wait for di days of Noah, while dem dey build di ark. Inside am few people, dat na eight souls, save through water.
Dis water na symbol of baptism, wey now dey save una, no be to wash dirt from di body, but na di answer of good conscience to God, through di resurrection of Jesus Christ,
wey dey for di right hand of God, as e don go heaven; and angels, authorities and powers don submit to am.
So since Christ suffer for us for flesh, make una arm una self with di same mind; because di one wey don suffer for flesh don stop from sin;
so that una no go live di rest of una time for flesh for di desire of men again, but for God will.
Because di time wey we don waste don enough for us to do wetin di Gentiles want, as we dey live for lewdness, desires, drunkenness, wild party, drinking party and disgusting idol worship.
Dem think say e strange say una no dey run with dem enter di same wild life, so dem dey blaspheme una:
dem go give account to di one wey ready to judge di living and di dead.
Because na for dis reason dem preach di Good News even to di dead, so that dem go face judgment like men for flesh, but live like God for spirit.
But di end of all things don near. So make una get sound mind, control una self and keep clear mind for prayer.
And above all things, make una love each other well well, because love dey cover plenty sins.
Welcome each other for house without complain.
As each person don receive gift, make una use am to serve each other, like good managers of di different kinds of God grace.

If anybody dey talk, make e talk like God words. If anybody dey serve, make e serve with di strength wey God dey give, so that for everything God go get glory through Jesus Christ, wey glory and power belong to forever and ever. Amen.
Dear ones, no wonder at di fire trial wey don come on una to test una, like say strange thing happen to una.
But since una dey share for di sufferings of Christ, make una rejoice; so that when im glory show, una go rejoice with plenty joy too.
If dem insult una for di name of Christ, una dey blessed, because di Spirit of glory and of God dey rest on una. For dem side dem dey blaspheme am, but for una side dem dey glorify am.
Make none of una suffer as murderer, or thief, or evildoer, or person wey dey meddle for other people matter.
But if person suffer as Christian, make e no shame, but make e glorify God for dis matter.
Because time don reach for judgment to begin for God house. If e begin with us first, wetin go be di end of dem wey no obey di Good News of God?
“If e hard for di righteous to save, wetin go happen to dem wey no fear God and to di sinner?”
So make dem wey dey suffer according to God will hand over dem souls to faithful Creator as dem dey do good.
So I urge di elders among una, as fellow elder and witness of di sufferings of Christ, and as person wey go share for di glory wey go show:
Shepherd God flock wey dey among una, as una dey watch over dem, no be by force but by free will, no be for dishonest gain but with willing heart;
no be as person wey dey rule di people wey dem give una, but as example to di flock.
When di chief Shepherd show, una go receive di crown of glory wey no dey fade.
Na so too, una young ones, submit to di elders. Yes, all of una wear humility, as una dey submit to each other; because “God dey resist di proud, but e dey give grace to di humble.”
So humble una self under God mighty hand, so that e go lift una up for di right time;
as una dey throw all una worry on am, because e dey care for una.
Keep clear mind and control una self. Dey watch. Una enemy, di devil, dey go about like lion wey dey roar, as e dey look who e go swallow.
Stand against am strong for una faith, as una know say una brothers wey dey di world dey pass through di same sufferings.
But make di God of all grace, wey call una to im glory wey no dey end through Christ Jesus, after una don suffer for small time, make una perfect, establish una, strengthen una and make una firm.
Make glory and power dey for am forever and ever. Amen.
Through Silvanus, our faithful brother, as I take am, I don write to una short, as I dey encourage and testify say dis na di true grace of God. Stand firm inside am.
Di one wey dey Babylon, wey God choose together with una, dey greet una; and Mark, my pikin, dey greet una too.
Greet each other with kiss of love. Peace dey with una all wey dey inside Christ Jesus. Amen.
